commentary.text: 90+14' The match has just finished.
90+13' Javi Puado (Espanyol) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the bottom right corner, but it's not enough to beat Pau Lopez who easily stops the effort.
90+13' Pau Lopez (Betis) picks up a yellow card.
90+12' Javi Puado (Espanyol) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+12' Valentin Gomez (Betis) is given a yellow card.
90+12' Having seen unsporting behavior, Iosu Galech shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Adrian (Betis) is the recipient.
90+10' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) gets a yellow card, off the field.
90+9' Referee Iosu Galech makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Espanyol. Let’s see what happens!
90+9' One of the Espanyol players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
90+7' Ramon Terrats (Espanyol) is about to take a corner kick.

90+7' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Espanyol.
90+4' Natan (Betis) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

90+3' Luca Koleosho drives to the by-line and dinks a lovely cross into the middle of the box. Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) wins the ball but his header is just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
90+2' A pass by Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
90+1' Here's the change. Cucho Hernandez leaves the pitch and Cedric Bakambu (Betis) comes on as a substitute.
90' The fourth official shows 11 min. of added time.
88' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
85' Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
83' Here is a change. Exposito is going off and Manolo Gonzalez gives the last tactical orders to Ramon Terrats (Espanyol).
83' Omar El Hilali goes off the pitch and Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol) comes on.
82' 9:5 – the corner kicks stats.

80' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Pau Lopez shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
77' Manuel Pellegrini prepares a substitution. Antony is replaced by Aitor Ruibal (Betis).
77' Substitution. Sergi Altimira (Betis) in, Pablo Fornals out.
76' Corner kick. Exposito (Espanyol) is ready to send the ball into the box.
74' Javi Puado (Espanyol) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

71' Antony (Betis) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
68' Substitution. Kike Garcia (Espanyol) has come on for Pol Lozano.
68' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to substitute Tyrhys Dolan and he is replaced by Luca Koleosho (Espanyol).
68' It is time for a substitution. Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) is on for Giovani Lo Celso.

67' A lofted pass evades the keeper and lands right on the head of Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) in the centre of the box, but his header sails narrowly wide of the right post when an empty net was beckoning. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
67' An attempted cross from Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) is cleared.
65' The Betis players are exchanging some short passes.
63' 1 - 2 Goal - 1:2! Pablo Fornals tees up Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Marko Dmitrovic.
62' Exposito (Espanyol) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

62' Espanyol earn a corner. Carlos Romero (Espanyol) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
61' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Iosu Galech saw the whole situation. There is a free kick near the sideline to Espanyol.
60' We are about to witness a substitution. Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) is replacing Pere Milla.
59' Espanyol enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

58' A sweet pass finds Javi Puado (Espanyol) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Pau Lopez is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
57' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) handles the ball inside the box. Betis get a free kick.
54' 1 - 1 Cucho Hernandez (Betis) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header low inside the right post. Excellent finish.
52' The linesman makes the right call and Espanyol will have a corner.

52' Pere Milla (Espanyol) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. Pau Lopez pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The referee signals a corner kick to Espanyol.

50' What a great touch by Pablo Fornals (Betis) after latching on to a precise pass on the edge of the box! He finds some space and rips a shot close to the left post. The goalkeeper makes an astonishing save, knocking the ball onto the post.
48' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) squanders a big chance! The ball rebounded out to him and he misdirects his shot well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
48' Exposito (Espanyol) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
47' The Espanyol players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.

45+5' Exposito (Espanyol) takes the corner.
45+5' Javi Puado (Espanyol) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. Espanyol will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

36' Javi Puado (Espanyol) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Espanyol win a corner.
35' The ball goes out of play and Betis have been awarded a corner kick.
35' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Betis will have a chance to score from a corner.
33' Pablo Fornals (Betis) is yellow-carded.
32' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) is penalised for holding. Iosu Galech signals a set piece. Betis win a free kick.
32' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
28' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
28' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Pere Milla (Espanyol) is given a yellow card.
27' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Antony (Betis).
25' Javi Puado (Espanyol) passes the ball onto Carlos Romero, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
22' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Betis for a penalty. Play continues.
20' 68:32 – the ratio of ball possession.
15' 1 - 0 Goal! Pol Lozano (Espanyol) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes into the top left corner. It's 1:0.
15' Exposito (Espanyol) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

14' Espanyol slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
12' The resulting corner from Exposito (Espanyol) comes to nothing.
12' Betis failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
10' Pablo Fornals (Betis) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
9' Iosu Galech interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Carlos Romero (Espanyol). Betis win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
8' Exposito (Espanyol) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

8' Javi Puado (Espanyol) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee points to the corner flag and Espanyol will take a corner.
7' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) touches the ball with his hand. Betis are awarded the free kick.

5' A free kick has been awarded to Espanyol.
